title: Marseille's old port Rising
author: Petra Winterbourne
blurb: Quentin Villalobos, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
